The Functional prompt fixes distinct mutation fixtures such as QC Save Alpha/Beta (:418-424), QC Restart Primary (:430-434), QC Concurrent Save (:440-445) and QC Version Sketch A/B/C (:466-470). `evidence/36/source-comparison.json` records SHA256 of compared sources, scans all five prompts and judge files, and finds no collision among fixed QC titles or distinctive hyphenated markers in the seed/reference; its only raw overlaps are generic protocol/style terms. A broken app with prefilled fixture titles or markers could fool a title/text-only check, but these values are absent here and the judge also requires actual save/revision/readback controls. A conforming app with an unrelated preexisting snippet of the same title is allowed by the prompt's identity-based readback and instruction to leave unknown records intact. This is a source comparison, not a configured judge or portal result.
